actions.name: Supply Chain Compromise via trojanized tax software files

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Executed malware installation files

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Bypassed User Access Control using COM and CMSTP
actions.description: Baiwang version invoked INF functions to use COM to bypass UAC and execute using CMSTP.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Installed malware as system processes

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Scheduled malware download two hours after tax software install
actions.description: Aisino trojanized file schedules the malware download two hours after the tax software installation.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Reinstalled partner process if deleted
actions.description: Aisino malware processes 'svm.exe' and 'svmm.exe' will download and reinstall their partner process if deleted.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Generated and stored UUID in registry for persistence
actions.description: Aisino malware 'svm.exe' generates and stores UUID in HKLM\Software\IDG\DA registry key.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Added registry values under services for persistence
actions.description: Baiwang malware added numerous values under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\services\WMPAssis.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Deployed uninstallers to remove malware files

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Deleted files and timestamps to remove indicators

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Hid files and directories

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Checked system version before continuing execution
actions.description: Baiwang malware checks if victim system is running 64-bit Windows 7 or above before continuing.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Encrypted and encoded logs
actions.description: Aisino 'plugin.exe' and 'mplugin.exe' logs are encrypted with SM4 block cipher and encoded in Base64.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Sent host environment information to C2

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: Used non-standard ports for telnet and malware network traffic

actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.
